Refactored the scanner to be simpler and cheaper on the hot path.

What changed:
- [BalancedParentheses.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/042_balanced_parentheses/BalancedParentheses.java:25) now uses a primitive `char[]` stack instead of boxing `Character` values into a `Deque`.
- [BalancedParentheses.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/042_balanced_parentheses/BalancedParentheses.java:34) now scans with a cached input length and a direct stack-depth check.
- [BracketProfile.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/042_balanced_parentheses/BracketProfile.java:29) now exposes small package-private classification helpers so the matcher reads more directly.
- [BracketProfile.java](/Users/allenjiang/Documents/ACE-Sycophancy-Codebase-Dataset/_worktrees/042_balanced_parentheses/BracketProfile.java:46) keeps validation/building in one pass while still rejecting duplicate or overlapping bracket pairs.

- Recompiled the source

1. fold the package-private helpers into a tiny internal matcher type, or
2. add tests for empty custom profiles and larger custom bracket sets.
